Market today: The bond market is in a rout, with 30-year Treasury yields hitting 2004 highs. This is the real driver, putting significant pressure on growth stocks like your tech and chip names, as higher rates make future earnings less valuable and increase borrowing costs.

Your holdings: SOXL (-34.89%) and SPAL (-34.29%) are flagged "SELL" by the scanner and show deep losses. Both are leveraged ETFs, meaning they decay and drops are amplified, especially on margin. Review their stops carefully.

Watch: Keep a close eye on Treasury yields; continued increases will be a headwind. Also, watch for any further tech sector weakness following Oracle's data center news.

Bottom line: The macro environment is challenging for your concentrated, leveraged book; focus on risk management for your underperforming positions.
plays: Review SOXL and SPAL stops; consider trimming these leveraged positions given their "SELL" status and significant losses.
No new buys today - hold and watch. The market mood and your existing leveraged exposure suggest caution.
